text: I feel slightly disoriented, both physically and intellectually. The tilted perspective and the muffled, ambiguous sounds evoke a sense of uncertainty and curiosity. The environment is modern and clinical—glass, lights, signs—suggesting order, but my senses are challenged. Arriving at the R+D wall, I sense the pulsing drive of progress and possibility, but also the abstraction of knowledge. I am both observer and participant, pulled between clarity and confusion, eager to find meaning in the randomness.
